name: gui_graph_new_target
description: GL-5b, from File > New Project > Blank with Studio's GUI only. On the Graph tab render.target_ref is placed from the palette, whose target combo offers New render target… in place of sending the user to the Frame Plan (decision 2): it opens the Frame Plan's own form on a name Studio proposes (decision 5, render_target), OK is one edit_render_targets the engine takes, and the reference is placed once the target is declared. The target is made Explicit format R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT (picked, not typed: a forward material pass writes only that, and the Scene color default is refused as a format mismatch). A material pass from the palette (forward_opaque_v1, which restarts the engine for the route default) is made to write that target -- the reference's line onto the pass's colour socket -- and the reference's line onto present's + input makes present show it: the picture changes. The Graph tab's Undo takes the last edit back: present reads nothing again and the picture is the one before. Typed: the project folder and name in New Project.
